scope: Every Lionel store part that names an item: the SKU names it, or an assembly's exploded-view parts breakdown lists the part. 55955 rows.
numberRule: Item Number = the store SKU without its wrapper (cs- in front, -p at the end); the complete SKU is in Notes
fitsRule: Fits = the item written into the part SKU, plus every item whose parts breakdown lists this part; SKU item first, then the rest in number order, no cap (a part that fits more than 100 items says how many in Notes)
calloutRule: The exploded-view callout is written to Notes only when every diagram agrees on it
